verdict.rationale: Retell documents an outbound-call API endpoint (POST /v2/create-phone-call). Phone numbers can be managed via the official CLI or imported from Twilio, Telnyx or Vonage. Inbound handling is implied by assigning agents to numbers and by reserved inbound concurrency. missing for 10: an explicitly documented API endpoint for buying or provisioning numbers, documented API configuration of inbound call routing, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision phone numbers and run both inbound and outbound calls through the platform's API

citations.quote: Install the Retell CLI to manage agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, and other Retell resources from your terminal with simple commands.
You set up a SIP trunk, configure your number to point to it, and import that number to Retell.
Reserved inbound concurrency protects inbound calls from being crowded out by outbound traffic.
